dialogues.speaker: Clorinde
dialogues.text: I rarely encounter opportunities to rest mid-journey. During battle, slowing down is even more out of the question.

dialogues.speaker: Clorinde
dialogues.text: However, given that this is not a solo operation, I will go along with what you think is best.

dialogues.speaker: Clorinde
dialogues.text: In any case, this is an acceptable place for a brief period of respite.
